reports.report: I modeled the game as a winning/losing position problem. A position $n$ is a winning position (W) if there's a move to a losing position (L) or to the target $N$. The target $N$ is reached by the player who writes it, so they win. Player $A$ starts by writing 1, and then player $B$ moves from 1. Thus, $N$ is type B if $f(1, N) = W$. By writing a script to compute $f(1, N)$ for all $N$, I found that the least $N > 400$ of type B is 512.
